fields.appearance: Travel-worn, cautious, and carrying a small bundle of possessions packed for sudden departure.
fields.backstory: A refugee escaped a border settlement destroyed by forces both neighboring states deny commanding.
fields.goals: Find safety for other survivors and gather proof of who ordered the attack.

fields.appearance: Keeps their face partly concealed and changes small details of dress whenever entering a new town.
fields.backstory: A fugitive was framed for stealing records that actually reveal widespread official corruption.
fields.goals: Recover the records, clear their name, and stay ahead of the true thieves.

fields.appearance: Maintains aristocratic habits despite patched clothing and a signet deliberately worn out of sight.
fields.backstory: A banished noble accepted blame for a sibling's failed plot to prevent the entire family from being executed.
fields.goals: Learn whether the sacrifice was worthwhile and build a life independent of the old title.

fields.appearance: Marked by old injuries and protective layers assembled from several different regions.
fields.backstory: A displaced survivor has rebuilt a home repeatedly as war, disaster, and prejudice forced each community onward.
fields.goals: Establish one lasting refuge and make it defensible without closing it to newcomers.

fields.appearance: Reserved and articulate, carrying banned pamphlets and correspondence in a false-bottomed case.
fields.backstory: A political exile advocated peaceful reform until the government declared even discussion of change treasonous.
fields.goals: Support reformers at home while preventing their movement from embracing indiscriminate violence.

fields.appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a revolutionary.
fields.backstory: Built a life as a revolutionary and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.
